import z3
import itertools

A = list(range(8))
B = list(range(8, 16))
possible = [(i, j) for i in A for j in B]
edge_vars = {(i, j): z3.Bool(f'e{i}_{j}') for i, j in possible}

s = z3.Solver()
# at least 21 edges
s.add(z3.Sum([z3.If(v, 1, 0) for v in edge_vars.values()]) >= 21)

# no C4: for every 2A 2B, not all 4 edges
for a_pair in itertools.combinations(A, 2):
    for b_pair in itertools.combinations(B, 2):
        e1 = edge_vars[(a_pair[0], b_pair[0])]
        e2 = edge_vars[(a_pair[0], b_pair[1])]
        e3 = edge_vars[(a_pair[1], b_pair[0])]
        e4 = edge_vars[(a_pair[1], b_pair[1])]
        s.add(z3.Or(z3.Not(e1), z3.Not(e2), z3.Not(e3), z3.Not(e4)))

# no C6
for a_comb in itertools.combinations(A, 3):
    for b_comb in itertools.combinations(B, 3):
        for a_ord in itertools.permutations(a_comb):
            for b_ord in itertools.permutations(b_comb):
                e1 = edge_vars[(a_ord[0], b_ord[0])]
                e2 = edge_vars[(a_ord[1], b_ord[0])]
                e3 = edge_vars[(a_ord[1], b_ord[1])]
                e4 = edge_vars[(a_ord[2], b_ord[1])]
                e5 = edge_vars[(a_ord[2], b_ord[2])]
                e6 = edge_vars[(a_ord[0], b_ord[2])]
                s.add(z3.Or([z3.Not(e) for e in (e1, e2, e3, e4, e5, e6)]))

print(s.check())
if s.check() == z3.sat:
    m = s.model()
    edges = [(i, j) for (i, j), v in edge_vars.items() if m.evaluate(v)]
    print(sorted(edges))
    print(len(edges))
else:
    print("unsat")

import z3
import itertools

A = list(range(8))
B = list(range(8, 16))
possible = [(i, j) for i in A for j in B]
edge_vars = {(i, j): z3.Bool(f'e{i}_{j}') for i, j in possible}

s = z3.Solver()
# at least 21 edges
s.add(z3.Sum([z3.If(v, 1, 0) for v in edge_vars.values()]) >= 21)

# no C4: for every 2A 2B, not all 4 edges
for a_pair in itertools.combinations(A, 2):
    for b_pair in itertools.combinations(B, 2):
        e1 = edge_vars[(a_pair[0], b_pair[0])]
        e2 = edge_vars[(a_pair[0], b_pair[1])]
        e3 = edge_vars[(a_pair[1], b_pair[0])]
        e4 = edge_vars[(a_pair[1], b_pair[1])]
        s.add(z3.Or(z3.Not(e1), z3.Not(e2), z3.Not(e3), z3.Not(e4)))

# no C6: for every 3A 3B, forbid the 6 edges of any alternating cycle
for a_comb in itertools.combinations(A, 3):
    for b_comb in itertools.combinations(B, 3):
        for perm_a in itertools.permutations(a_comb):
            for perm_b in itertools.permutations(b_comb):
                edges_cycle = [
                    edge_vars[(perm_a[0], perm_b[0])],
                    edge_vars[(perm_a[1], perm_b[0])],
                    edge_vars[(perm_a[1], perm_b[1])],
                    edge_vars[(perm_a[2], perm_b[1])],
                    edge_vars[(perm_a[2], perm_b[2])],
                    edge_vars[(perm_a[0], perm_b[2])]
                ]
                s.add(z3.Or([z3.Not(e) for e in edges_cycle]))

print(s.check())
if str(s.check()) == 'sat':
    m = s.model()
    edges = [(i, j) for (i, j), v in edge_vars.items() if m.evaluate(v)]
    print(sorted(edges))
    print(len(edges))
else:
    print("unsat")
